subject: Q2 forecast: CRM pipeline scrub & commit review
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
To: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.ai>, Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.ai>, Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwood.ai>
Cc: 
Date: Mon, 1 Mar 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Q2 forecast: CRM pipeline scrub & commit review

Team — quick HQ note as finance closes the Q2 commit. We need a targeted CRM cleanup pass for all deals currently in Commit/Commit-At-Risk/Best Case so the forecast reflects accurate amounts and product SKUs. Please do the following by end-of-day Wednesday (2026-03-03):

- Validate "Amount" matches negotiated order amount (no list-price placeholders).
- Confirm Product/SKU line items (Core vs. Premium ingestion, Dedicated vs. Hosted).
- Update "Next Steps" with the current blocker (e.g., PO pending, SOC2 evidence, legal redlines).
- Set a realistic "Probability" (not auto-fill). Use 90%+ only if procurement signed or DocuSign executed.
- Add the primary procurement contact in the contact list (name + email).

I've attached a CSV extract (acme_commit_list_q2.csv) with the deals I pulled that look like Commit or at-risk. Priyom — I included the ACME rows you own. Rishi — please run a quick sweep on any large new pipeline that looks committed. Grace — can you pull a final HubSpot report after updates so I can share with Finance?

If any deal needs a quick sync with me (15 min), flag here and I'll jump on it. This is time-boxed: accurate CRM = better predictions (and fewer surprises for the ops team).

Thanks —
Marissa
Marissa Cole
Head of Revenue Operations
Redwood Inference

Attachment: acme_commit_list_q2.csv (CSV, 24 KB)

From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.ai>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.ai>, Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 1 Mar 2026 11:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Q2 forecast: CRM pipeline scrub & commit review

Thanks Marissa — sounds good. Quick clarification: for ACME, there are two SKUs on the quoting side (core-ingest, core-serve). Which SKU should be primary on the deal record for forecasting? The quote currently lists both and amount is split across line items.

My suggested approach: set the deal-level Product/SKU to the revenue-recognized SKU (core-serve) and add the other SKU as a line-item note. That preserves gross amount while keeping forecasting buckets clean. Thoughts?

-- Rishi

Date: Tue, 2 Mar 2026 14:28:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Q2 forecast: CRM pipeline scrub & commit review

Marissa — done for the ACME rows I own. Summary of changes I made:

- ACME-CORE-001: Amount corrected from $150,000 (list) to $112,500 (negotiated discount). Product set to "Core-Serve"; note added: "includes core-ingest add-on". Probability set to 95% (PO received, awaiting invoice schedule).
- ACME-CORE-002: Set probability to 40% (internal legal still redlining terms). Next step: Legal sync (assigned to Priyom).
- ACME-CORE-003: Marked as Best Case; moved amount to $0 until procurement confirms budget.

I attached an updated CSV export of my ACME rows (acme_commit_list_q2.csv) and the forecast template for Finance (forecast_template_v2.xlsx). I also added Aisha Patel (aisha.patel@acmehealth.com) to the contact field on ACME-CORE-001 per her request.

If you want, I can run a small HubSpot filter and export all Commit deals in the US region and drop it in Drive — should save Grace some time.

Attachment: acme_commit_list_q2.csv (CSV, 18 KB)
Attachment: forecast_template_v2.xlsx (XLSX, 42 KB)

Date: Tue, 3 Mar 2026 16:45:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Q2 forecast: CRM pipeline scrub & commit review

Great work — thank you. Notes and next steps: 

- Approach approved: use revenue-recognized SKU as the deal-level Product/SKU and include add-on SKUs in the line-item notes (Rishi's suggestion). This keeps MRR/ARR buckets accurate for Finance and maps to our reporting taxonomy.
- Priyom — thanks for updating ACME-CORE-001/002/003. I checked the records and the amounts match the CSV you attached.
- Grace — can you run the HubSpot "Commit Final" view after EOD Wed and export PDF/CSV to the Drive link above? I will then share the combined report with Finance and Ops.
- Everyone: double-check probability fields. Finance will accept changes through Thu morning; after that we lock the commit.

If there are any outstanding procurement docs from Acme, loop me in. I'm copying the external contact here for visibility: Aisha Patel <aisha.patel@acmehealth.com>.

Thanks again — short win for forecast reliability.

Marissa
Head of Revenue Operations
Redwood Inference
